preserved_scope.target: Recover the original predictive-density comparison for inferred astrocytic peak times. The May 2026 preprint uses WAIC to compare four distribution families during conditioning and recall; final-paper endpoint correspondence must be verified before activation.
preserved_scope.full_panel: Preserve all four density-family WAIC comparisons in conditioning, recall A, recall B and each recall context separately for females and males. The inspected habituation source supports power-law and uniform comparisons; any other habituation-family rows require source authentication and are not declared scalar findings here. Retain complete inferred-peak distributions, sex-stratified power-law exponent posterior arrays, event-count/sequence controls and temporal width/variability companions. Posterior arrays without an identified source point summary must not be reduced to invented scalar findings. Complete final-version tables, arrays and animal/cell support remain unauthenticated, so the scalar list is not a complete representation of the original panel.
preserved_scope.qualification: Preserve all prior records. Authorized conditioning/recall/sex four-family WAIC comparison remains the primary; source fit diagnostics remain required for interpretation. HAB, event-count tests, temporal compression/stability, sequence and behavior evidence retain their distinct or claim-dependent roles and are not automatic universal WAIC gates.
preserved_scope.accepted_retained_associated_scope:
empirical_learning_baseline: HAB density/event/sequence evidence remains a distinct baseline comparison. It is necessary for an additional claim that temporal organization emerges after learning, but is not automatically part of the authorized conditioning/recall/sex WAIC completion rule.
empirical_temporal_organization: Peak-width/peak-time slope and between-event variability remain separate compression/stability findings, required for those added interpretations rather than substituted for predictive density.
empirical_sequence_and_behavior: Historical odd/even rho, shuffle tests, cross-day sequence preservation and behavioral associations retain their own source semantics and scopes; they neither satisfy nor automatically gate WAIC.
interpretive_event_control: Exact event eligibility/count support is a core input requirement. Source event-count hypothesis tests are retained controls for sex/context biological interpretations, not additional ordered predictive scores.
prospective_extension: New held-animal splits, changed observation units or expanded all-context biological claims remain explicitly named extensions requiring scientific justification.

source_authority.primary_scope: Authorized four-family peak-time predictive-density comparison in conditioning, recall contexts A/B and original recall sex strata, with exact model-input/comparison support and source fit diagnostics. No automatic HAB, all-companion or whole-paper requirement.

qualification: Preserved bytes are source evidence and provenance, not a second active reproduction contract. Their earlier scope or criteria do not override the accepted active scope. No empirical execution, scientific success, paired outcome admission or identity release is established.
